scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.android:sync: npm run build -w web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run build -w web && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build -w web && npx cap sync ios
